```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results = "hide"}
shift<-function(x,shift_by){
  stopifnot(is.numeric(shift_by))
  stopifnot(is.numeric(x))
  
  if (length(shift_by)>1)
    return(sapply(shift_by,shift, x=x))
  
  out<-NULL
  abs_shift_by=abs(shift_by)
  if (shift_by > 0 )
    out<-c(tail(x,-abs_shift_by),rep(NA,abs_shift_by))
  else if (shift_by < 0 )
    out<-c(rep(NA,abs_shift_by), head(x,-abs_shift_by))
  else
    out<-x
  out
}
```

**The analytical procedure:**

- To study participants' psychological functioning over time, we combined data from nine survey waves collected between 2020 and 2025 (5 annual, 4 COVID-specific):

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple"}
## Overview of waves

  1. *COVID wave I* (*N* = 10 331): March - April 2020
  
  2. *COVID wave II* (*N* = 17 157): September - November 2020
  
  3. *End of 2020* (*N* = 30 158): December 2020
  
  4. *COVID wave III* (*N* = 27 811): March - May 2021
  
  5. *End of 2021* (*N* = 21 112): December 2021
  
  6. *Post-COVID* (*N* = 24 295): March-April 2022
  
  7. *End of 2022* (*N* = 16 836): October 2022
  
  8. *End of 2024* (*N* = 15 065): December 2024
  
  9. *End of 2025* (*N* = 10 296): December 2025
:::

- Only respondents who participated in a sufficient number of waves were included (**(#waves/2)+1**), ensuring that the trends reflect genuine longitudinal change rather than one-off responses. 

- To correct for over- or under-representation of specific sociodemographic groups, responses were **weighted** by age group, gender, and region, separately for each wave. 

- For data quality and reliability, sociodemographic subgroups with **fewer than 40 participants within a wave** were excluded from analyses. Weighted mean scores were then calculated for each item at each wave, and vizualised as longitudinal trends. Alongside this, we checked whether the sociodemographic composition of the sample differed across waves using descriptive statistics and chi-square tests (see tab 'Sociodemographics').

::: {.callout-tip}
Double click on a variable in the legend to isolate the means in the figure or make your own combinations by adding variables in the legend
:::

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.asp=0.3, dpi=300}
items <- cols

make_wave_long <- function(df, wave_id, cols) {
  cols_here <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if (length(cols_here) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df %>%
    select(email, weights, all_of(cols_here)) %>%   # <-- include weights
    mutate(wave = wave_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(cols_here),
      names_to = "item",
      values_to = "score"
    )
}

df_long <- bind_rows(
  make_wave_long(df2020begin,     1, cols),
  make_wave_long(df2020wave2,     2, cols),
  make_wave_long(df2020long,      3, cols),
  make_wave_long(dfwave3,         4, cols),
  make_wave_long(df2021long,      5, cols),
  make_wave_long(df2022postcovid, 6, cols),
  make_wave_long(df2022long,      7, cols),
  make_wave_long(df2024long,      8, cols),
  make_wave_long(df2025long,      9, cols)
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(score)) %>%                      # drop NAs per-item (not whole rows)
  mutate(item = factor(item, levels = cols))

pformat <- function(p.value){
  unclass(symnum(p.value, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE, 
                 cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), 
                 symbols = c("***", "**", "*", " ")))
}

plot_list = list()
plot_list3 = list()
sociodemo <- c()
test <- c()
testlabels <- c()

for(j in 1:length(variableslist)) {
  i <- 1
  variables <- variableslist[[j]]
  
  sociodemo <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables)) # lengte aanpassen
  test <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen worden gemaakt
    sociodemo[[i]] <- table(dfsub$group,dfsub[,variables[i]],exclude=NA)
  }
  
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## chi squares worden berekend
    test[[i]] <- paste('χ2(',chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$parameter,') = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$statistic,2),', p = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value,2),
                       pformat(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value),
                       sep="")
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen in percentages
    sociodemo[[i]] <- as.data.frame(round(prop.table(sociodemo[[i]],1)*100,2))
  }
  
  testlabels <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## p waarde 0 wordt vervangen door <.001
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) <.001){
      testlabels[[i]] <- gsub("p = 0","p = <.001",test[[i]])
    } else {
      testlabels[[i]] <- test[[i]]
    }
  }
  testlabels
  
  
  names(sociodemo)<- names[[j]]
  
  g<-list() # aanmaken van figuren
  a <- sociodemo
  for(i in 1:length(a)) {
    p = ggplot(reshape2::melt(a[[i]]), aes(as.factor(Var1), value, 
                                           fill=as.factor(Var2), 
                                           label=paste(round(value, 0),sep="") ))+
      geom_col()+geom_text(position=position_stack(vjust=0.5))+
      coord_flip()+scale_fill_brewer(type="seq", palette=1)+
      labs(x="", y="", title=names(a)[i], fill = "Categorieën: ",
           subtitle=testlabels[i]
      )+
      theme_hc(base_size = 10)+
      theme(legend.position='right')
    g[[i]] = p
    
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## er wordt gecheckt welke significant is of niet
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) >.05){
      g[[i]] <- g[[i]] + scale_fill_brewer(type="seq",palette=6)
    }  
  }
  
  # figuur ----
  
  plot_list[[j]] <- ggarrange(plotlist=g, align = "hv",# totale plot
                              common.legend=FALSE,
                              ncol = 1, nrow = 3 # aantal rijen en kolommen
  )
}


mean_df <- df_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(wave, item) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sum_w = sum(weights[!is.na(score) & !is.na(weights)], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_w = ifelse(sum_w > 0,
                    sum(score * weights, na.rm = TRUE) / sum_w,
                    NA_real_),
    n = sum(!is.na(score)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )%>%as.data.frame()
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.asp=0.3, dpi=300}
items <- cols

make_wave_long <- function(df, wave_id, cols) {
  cols_here <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if (length(cols_here) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df %>%
    select(email, weights, all_of(cols_here)) %>%   # <-- include weights
    mutate(wave = wave_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(cols_here),
      names_to = "item",
      values_to = "score"
    )
}

  unclass(symnum(p.value, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE, 
                 cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), 
                 symbols = c("***", "**", "*", " ")))
}

plot_list = list()
plot_list3 = list()
sociodemo <- c()
test <- c()
testlabels <- c()

for(j in 1:length(variableslist)) {
  i <- 1
  variables <- variableslist[[j]]
  
  sociodemo <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables)) # lengte aanpassen
  test <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen worden gemaakt
    sociodemo[[i]] <- table(dfsub$group,dfsub[,variables[i]],exclude=NA)
  }
  
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## chi squares worden berekend
    test[[i]] <- paste('χ2(',chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$parameter,') = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$statistic,2),', p = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value,2),
                       pformat(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value),
                       sep="")
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen in percentages
    sociodemo[[i]] <- as.data.frame(round(prop.table(sociodemo[[i]],1)*100,2))
  }
  
  testlabels <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## p waarde 0 wordt vervangen door <.001
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) <.001){
      testlabels[[i]] <- gsub("p = 0","p = <.001",test[[i]])
    } else {
      testlabels[[i]] <- test[[i]]
    }
  }
  testlabels
  
  
  names(sociodemo)<- names[[j]]
  
  g<-list() # aanmaken van figuren
  a <- sociodemo
  for(i in 1:length(a)) {
    p = ggplot(reshape2::melt(a[[i]]), aes(as.factor(Var1), value, 
                                           fill=as.factor(Var2), 
                                           label=paste(round(value, 0),sep="") ))+
      geom_col()+geom_text(position=position_stack(vjust=0.5))+
      coord_flip()+scale_fill_brewer(type="seq", palette=1)+
      labs(x="", y="", title=names(a)[i], fill = "Categorieën: ",
           subtitle=testlabels[i]
      )+
      theme_hc(base_size = 10)+
      theme(legend.position='right')
    g[[i]] = p
    
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## er wordt gecheckt welke significant is of niet
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) >.05){
      g[[i]] <- g[[i]] + scale_fill_brewer(type="seq",palette=6)
    }  
  }
  
  # figuur ----
  
  plot_list[[j]] <- ggarrange(plotlist=g, align = "hv",# totale plot
                              common.legend=FALSE,
                              ncol = 1, nrow = 3 # aantal rijen en kolommen
  )
}


mean_df <- df_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(wave, item) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sum_w = sum(weights[!is.na(score) & !is.na(weights)], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_w = ifelse(sum_w > 0,
                    sum(score * weights, na.rm = TRUE) / sum_w,
                    NA_real_),
    n = sum(!is.na(score)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )%>%as.data.frame()
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.asp=0.3, dpi=300}
items <- cols

make_wave_long <- function(df, wave_id, cols) {
  cols_here <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if (length(cols_here) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df %>%
    select(email, weights, all_of(cols_here)) %>%   # <-- include weights
    mutate(wave = wave_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(cols_here),
      names_to = "item",
      values_to = "score"
    )
}

                       pformat(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value),
                       sep="")
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen in percentages
    sociodemo[[i]] <- as.data.frame(round(prop.table(sociodemo[[i]],1)*100,2))
  }
  
  testlabels <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## p waarde 0 wordt vervangen door <.001
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) <.001){
      testlabels[[i]] <- gsub("p = 0","p = <.001",test[[i]])
    } else {
      testlabels[[i]] <- test[[i]]
    }
  }
  testlabels
  
  
  names(sociodemo)<- names[[j]]
  
  g<-list() # aanmaken van figuren
  a <- sociodemo
  for(i in 1:length(a)) {
    p = ggplot(reshape2::melt(a[[i]]), aes(as.factor(Var1), value, 
                                           fill=as.factor(Var2), 
                                           label=paste(round(value, 0),sep="") ))+
      geom_col()+geom_text(position=position_stack(vjust=0.5))+
      coord_flip()+scale_fill_brewer(type="seq", palette=1)+
      labs(x="", y="", title=names(a)[i], fill = "Categorieën: ",
           subtitle=testlabels[i]
      )+
      theme_hc(base_size = 10)+
      theme(legend.position='right')
    g[[i]] = p
    
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## er wordt gecheckt welke significant is of niet
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) >.05){
      g[[i]] <- g[[i]] + scale_fill_brewer(type="seq",palette=6)
    }  
  }
  
  # figuur ----
  
  plot_list[[j]] <- ggarrange(plotlist=g, align = "hv",# totale plot
                              common.legend=FALSE,
                              ncol = 1, nrow = 3 # aantal rijen en kolommen
  )
}


mean_df <- df_long %>%

  dplyr::summarise(

                    sum(score * weights, na.rm = TRUE) / sum_w,
                    NA_real_),
    n = sum(!is.na(score)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )%>%as.data.frame()
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.asp=0.3, dpi=300}
items <- cols

make_wave_long <- function(df, wave_id, cols) {
  cols_here <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if (length(cols_here) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df %>%
    select(email, weights, all_of(cols_here)) %>%   # <-- include weights
    mutate(wave = wave_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(cols_here),
      names_to = "item",
      values_to = "score"
    )
}

pformat <- function(p.value){
  unclass(symnum(p.value, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE, 
                 cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), 
                 symbols = c("***", "**", "*", " ")))
}

plot_list = list()
plot_list3 = list()
sociodemo <- c()
test <- c()
testlabels <- c()

for(j in 1:length(variableslist)) {
  i <- 1
  variables <- variableslist[[j]]
  
  sociodemo <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables)) # lengte aanpassen
  test <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen worden gemaakt
    sociodemo[[i]] <- table(dfsub$group,dfsub[,variables[i]],exclude=NA)
  }
  
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## chi squares worden berekend
    test[[i]] <- paste('χ2(',chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$parameter,') = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$statistic,2),', p = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value,2),
                       pformat(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value),
                       sep="")
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen in percentages
    sociodemo[[i]] <- as.data.frame(round(prop.table(sociodemo[[i]],1)*100,2))
  }
  
  testlabels <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## p waarde 0 wordt vervangen door <.001
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) <.001){
      testlabels[[i]] <- gsub("p = 0","p = <.001",test[[i]])
    } else {
      testlabels[[i]] <- test[[i]]
    }
  }
  testlabels
  
  
  names(sociodemo)<- names[[j]]
  
  g<-list() # aanmaken van figuren
  a <- sociodemo
  for(i in 1:length(a)) {
    p = ggplot(reshape2::melt(a[[i]]), aes(as.factor(Var1), value, 
                                           fill=as.factor(Var2), 
                                           label=paste(round(value, 0),sep="") ))+
      geom_col()+geom_text(position=position_stack(vjust=0.5))+
      coord_flip()+scale_fill_brewer(type="seq", palette=1)+
      labs(x="", y="", title=names(a)[i], fill = "Categorieën: ",
           subtitle=testlabels[i]
      )+
      theme_hc(base_size = 10)+
      theme(legend.position='right')
    g[[i]] = p
    
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## er wordt gecheckt welke significant is of niet
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) >.05){
      g[[i]] <- g[[i]] + scale_fill_brewer(type="seq",palette=6)
    }  
  }
  
  # figuur ----
  
  plot_list[[j]] <- ggarrange(plotlist=g, align = "hv",# totale plot
                              common.legend=FALSE,
                              ncol = 1, nrow = 3 # aantal rijen en kolommen
  )
}


mean_df <- df_long %>%

  dplyr::summarise(

                    sum(score * weights, na.rm = TRUE) / sum_w,
                    NA_real_),
    n = sum(!is.na(score)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )%>%as.data.frame()
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.asp=0.3, dpi=300}
items <- cols

make_wave_long <- function(df, wave_id, cols) {
  cols_here <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if (length(cols_here) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df %>%
    select(email, weights, all_of(cols_here)) %>%   # <-- include weights
    mutate(wave = wave_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(cols_here),
      names_to = "item",
      values_to = "score"
    )
}

  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## p waarde 0 wordt vervangen door <.001
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) <.001){
      testlabels[[i]] <- gsub("p = 0","p = <.001",test[[i]])
    } else {
      testlabels[[i]] <- test[[i]]
    }
  }
  testlabels
  
  
  names(sociodemo)<- names[[j]]
  
  g<-list() # aanmaken van figuren
  a <- sociodemo
  for(i in 1:length(a)) {
    p = ggplot(reshape2::melt(a[[i]]), aes(as.factor(Var1), value, 
                                           fill=as.factor(Var2), 
                                           label=paste(round(value, 0),sep="") ))+
      geom_col()+geom_text(position=position_stack(vjust=0.5))+
      coord_flip()+scale_fill_brewer(type="seq", palette=1)+
      labs(x="", y="", title=names(a)[i], fill = "Categorieën: ",
           subtitle=testlabels[i]
      )+
      theme_hc(base_size = 10)+
      theme(legend.position='right')
    g[[i]] = p
    
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## er wordt gecheckt welke significant is of niet
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) >.05){
      g[[i]] <- g[[i]] + scale_fill_brewer(type="seq",palette=6)
    }  
  }
  
  # figuur ----
  
  plot_list[[j]] <- ggarrange(plotlist=g, align = "hv",# totale plot
                              common.legend=FALSE,
                              ncol = 1, nrow = 3 # aantal rijen en kolommen
  )
}


mean_df <- df_long %>%

  )%>%as.data.frame()
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.asp=0.3, dpi=300}
items <- cols

make_wave_long <- function(df, wave_id, cols) {
  cols_here <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if (length(cols_here) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df %>%
    select(email, weights, all_of(cols_here)) %>%   # <-- include weights
    mutate(wave = wave_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(cols_here),
      names_to = "item",
      values_to = "score"
    )
}

pformat <- function(p.value){
  unclass(symnum(p.value, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE, 
                 cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), 
                 symbols = c("***", "**", "*", " ")))
}

plot_list = list()
plot_list3 = list()
sociodemo <- c()
test <- c()
testlabels <- c()

for(j in 1:length(variableslist)) {
  i <- 1
  variables <- variableslist[[j]]
  
  sociodemo <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables)) # lengte aanpassen
  test <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen worden gemaakt
    sociodemo[[i]] <- table(dfsub$group,dfsub[,variables[i]],exclude=NA)
  }
  
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## chi squares worden berekend
    test[[i]] <- paste('χ2(',chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$parameter,') = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$statistic,2),', p = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value,2),
                       pformat(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value),
                       sep="")
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen in percentages
    sociodemo[[i]] <- as.data.frame(round(prop.table(sociodemo[[i]],1)*100,2))
  }
  
  testlabels <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## p waarde 0 wordt vervangen door <.001
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) <.001){
      testlabels[[i]] <- gsub("p = 0","p = <.001",test[[i]])
    } else {
      testlabels[[i]] <- test[[i]]
    }
  }
  testlabels
  
  
  names(sociodemo)<- names[[j]]
  
  g<-list() # aanmaken van figuren
  a <- sociodemo
  for(i in 1:length(a)) {
    p = ggplot(reshape2::melt(a[[i]]), aes(as.factor(Var1), value, 
                                           fill=as.factor(Var2), 
                                           label=paste(round(value, 0),sep="") ))+
      geom_col()+geom_text(position=position_stack(vjust=0.5))+
      coord_flip()+scale_fill_brewer(type="seq", palette=1)+
      labs(x="", y="", title=names(a)[i], fill = "Categorieën: ",
           subtitle=testlabels[i]
      )+
      theme_hc(base_size = 10)+
      theme(legend.position='right')
    g[[i]] = p
    
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## er wordt gecheckt welke significant is of niet
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) >.05){
      g[[i]] <- g[[i]] + scale_fill_brewer(type="seq",palette=6)
    }  
  }
  
  # figuur ----
  
  plot_list[[j]] <- ggarrange(plotlist=g, align = "hv",# totale plot
                              common.legend=FALSE,
                              ncol = 1, nrow = 3 # aantal rijen en kolommen
  )
}


mean_df <- df_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(wave, item) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sum_w = sum(weights[!is.na(score) & !is.na(weights)], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_w = ifelse(sum_w > 0,
                    sum(score * weights, na.rm = TRUE) / sum_w,
                    NA_real_),
    n = sum(!is.na(score)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )%>%as.data.frame()

items_with_lines <- mean_df %>%
  dplyr::count(item) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n >= 2) %>%   # at least two waves → line possible
  dplyr::pull(item)

mean_df_lines <- mean_df %>%
  filter(item %in% items_with_lines)

mean_df$item <- as.factor(mean_df$item)
mean_df <- mean_df %>%
  mutate(item_label = col_labels[item])
mean_df[which(mean_df$n<100),] <- NA

mean_df_lines$item <- as.factor(mean_df_lines$item)
mean_df_lines <- mean_df_lines %>%
  mutate(item_label = col_labels[item])

mean_df_lines[which(mean_df_lines$n<100),] <- NA

mean_df_lines$wave <- as.factor(mean_df_lines$wave);levels(mean_df_lines$item) <- codenames;mean_df_lines<-na.omit(mean_df_lines)

p <- ggplot(mean_df,
            aes(
              x = wave,
              y = mean_w,
              color = item,
              shape = item,
              group = item,
              text = paste0(
                "Item: ", item_label,
                "<br>Code: ", item,
                "<br>Wave: ", wave,
                "<br>Weighted mean: ", round(mean_w, 2),
                "<br>N: ", n
              )
            )) +

    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +

    values = item_colors,

  )+

   scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "1"='COVID<br>wave I',
    "2"= 'COVID<br>wave II',
    "3"='End of<br>2020',
    "4"='COVID<br>wave III',
    "5"='End of<br>2021',
    "6"='Post-COVID',
    "7"='End of<br>2022',
    "8"='End of<br>2024',
    "9"='End of<br>2025'
  ))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1, 5), expand = expansion(mult = c(.02, .05))) +
  labs(
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.asp=0.3, dpi=300}
items <- cols

make_wave_long <- function(df, wave_id, cols) {
  cols_here <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if (length(cols_here) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df %>%
    select(email, weights, all_of(cols_here)) %>%   # <-- include weights
    mutate(wave = wave_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(cols_here),
      names_to = "item",
      values_to = "score"
    )
}

dfsub <- as.data.frame(dfsub)

variableslist <- list(
  fig0 = c('age_group','gender','region'))
names <- list(
  fig0 = c('Age group','Gender','Region'))

pformat <- function(p.value){
  unclass(symnum(p.value, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE, 
                 cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), 
                 symbols = c("***", "**", "*", " ")))
}

plot_list = list()
plot_list3 = list()
sociodemo <- c()
test <- c()
testlabels <- c()

for(j in 1:length(variableslist)) {
  i <- 1
  variables <- variableslist[[j]]
  
  sociodemo <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables)) # lengte aanpassen
  test <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen worden gemaakt
    sociodemo[[i]] <- table(dfsub$group,dfsub[,variables[i]],exclude=NA)
  }
  
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## chi squares worden berekend
    test[[i]] <- paste('χ2(',chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$parameter,') = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$statistic,2),', p = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value,2),
                       pformat(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value),
                       sep="")
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen in percentages
    sociodemo[[i]] <- as.data.frame(round(prop.table(sociodemo[[i]],1)*100,2))
  }
  
  testlabels <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## p waarde 0 wordt vervangen door <.001
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) <.001){
      testlabels[[i]] <- gsub("p = 0","p = <.001",test[[i]])
    } else {
      testlabels[[i]] <- test[[i]]
    }
  }
  testlabels
  
  
  names(sociodemo)<- names[[j]]
  
  g<-list() # aanmaken van figuren
  a <- sociodemo
  for(i in 1:length(a)) {
    p = ggplot(reshape2::melt(a[[i]]), aes(as.factor(Var1), value, 
                                           fill=as.factor(Var2), 
                                           label=paste(round(value, 0),sep="") ))+
      geom_col()+geom_text(position=position_stack(vjust=0.5))+
      coord_flip()+scale_fill_brewer(type="seq", palette=1)+
      labs(x="", y="", title=names(a)[i], fill = "Categorieën: ",
           subtitle=testlabels[i]
      )+
      theme_hc(base_size = 10)+
      theme(legend.position='right')
    g[[i]] = p
    
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## er wordt gecheckt welke significant is of niet
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) >.05){
      g[[i]] <- g[[i]] + scale_fill_brewer(type="seq",palette=6)
    }  
  }
  
  # figuur ----
  
  plot_list[[j]] <- ggarrange(plotlist=g, align = "hv",# totale plot
                              common.legend=FALSE,
                              ncol = 1, nrow = 3 # aantal rijen en kolommen
  )
}


mean_df <- df_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(wave, item) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sum_w = sum(weights[!is.na(score) & !is.na(weights)], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_w = ifelse(sum_w > 0,
                    sum(score * weights, na.rm = TRUE) / sum_w,
                    NA_real_),
    n = sum(!is.na(score)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )%>%as.data.frame()

items_with_lines <- mean_df %>%
  dplyr::count(item) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n >= 2) %>%   # at least two waves → line possible
  dplyr::pull(item)

  filter(item %in% items_with_lines)

mean_df[which(mean_df$n<100),] <- NA

mean_df_lines <- mean_df_lines %>%

 scale_color_manual(

  ))+
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.asp=0.3, dpi=300}
items <- cols

make_wave_long <- function(df, wave_id, cols) {
  cols_here <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if (length(cols_here) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df %>%
    select(email, weights, all_of(cols_here)) %>%   # <-- include weights
    mutate(wave = wave_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(cols_here),
      names_to = "item",
      values_to = "score"
    )
}

dfsub <- dfsub[!is.na(dfsub$region),]
dfsub <- dfsub[!is.na(dfsub$group),]
dfsub <- droplevels(dfsub)
dfsub <- as.data.frame(dfsub)

variableslist <- list(
  fig0 = c('age_group','gender','region'))
names <- list(
  fig0 = c('Age group','Gender','Region'))

pformat <- function(p.value){
  unclass(symnum(p.value, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE, 
                 cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), 
                 symbols = c("***", "**", "*", " ")))
}

plot_list = list()
plot_list3 = list()
sociodemo <- c()
test <- c()
testlabels <- c()

for(j in 1:length(variableslist)) {
  i <- 1
  variables <- variableslist[[j]]
  
  sociodemo <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables)) # lengte aanpassen
  test <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen worden gemaakt
    sociodemo[[i]] <- table(dfsub$group,dfsub[,variables[i]],exclude=NA)
  }
  
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## chi squares worden berekend
    test[[i]] <- paste('χ2(',chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$parameter,') = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$statistic,2),', p = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value,2),
                       pformat(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value),
                       sep="")
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen in percentages
    sociodemo[[i]] <- as.data.frame(round(prop.table(sociodemo[[i]],1)*100,2))
  }
  
  testlabels <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## p waarde 0 wordt vervangen door <.001
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) <.001){
      testlabels[[i]] <- gsub("p = 0","p = <.001",test[[i]])
    } else {
      testlabels[[i]] <- test[[i]]
    }
  }
  testlabels
  
  
  names(sociodemo)<- names[[j]]
  
  g<-list() # aanmaken van figuren
  a <- sociodemo
  for(i in 1:length(a)) {
    p = ggplot(reshape2::melt(a[[i]]), aes(as.factor(Var1), value, 
                                           fill=as.factor(Var2), 
                                           label=paste(round(value, 0),sep="") ))+
      geom_col()+geom_text(position=position_stack(vjust=0.5))+
      coord_flip()+scale_fill_brewer(type="seq", palette=1)+
      labs(x="", y="", title=names(a)[i], fill = "Categorieën: ",
           subtitle=testlabels[i]
      )+
      theme_hc(base_size = 10)+
      theme(legend.position='right')
    g[[i]] = p
    
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## er wordt gecheckt welke significant is of niet
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) >.05){
      g[[i]] <- g[[i]] + scale_fill_brewer(type="seq",palette=6)
    }  
  }
  
  # figuur ----
  
  plot_list[[j]] <- ggarrange(plotlist=g, align = "hv",# totale plot
                              common.legend=FALSE,
                              ncol = 1, nrow = 3 # aantal rijen en kolommen
  )
}


mean_df <- df_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(wave, item) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sum_w = sum(weights[!is.na(score) & !is.na(weights)], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_w = ifelse(sum_w > 0,
                    sum(score * weights, na.rm = TRUE) / sum_w,
                    NA_real_),
    n = sum(!is.na(score)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )%>%as.data.frame()

  dplyr::count(item) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n >= 2) %>%   # at least two waves → line possible
  dplyr::pull(item)

  filter(item %in% items_with_lines)

mean_df[which(mean_df$n<100),] <- NA

 scale_color_manual(
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.asp=0.3, dpi=300}
items <- cols

make_wave_long <- function(df, wave_id, cols) {
  cols_here <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if (length(cols_here) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df %>%
    select(email, weights, all_of(cols_here)) %>%   # <-- include weights
    mutate(wave = wave_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(cols_here),
      names_to = "item",
      values_to = "score"
    )
}

  make_wave_long(dfwave3,         4, cols),

variableslist <- list(
  fig0 = c('age_group','gender','region'))
names <- list(
  fig0 = c('Age group','Gender','Region'))

pformat <- function(p.value){
  unclass(symnum(p.value, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE, 
                 cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), 
                 symbols = c("***", "**", "*", " ")))
}

plot_list = list()
plot_list3 = list()
sociodemo <- c()
test <- c()
testlabels <- c()

for(j in 1:length(variableslist)) {
  i <- 1
  variables <- variableslist[[j]]
  
  sociodemo <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables)) # lengte aanpassen
  test <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen worden gemaakt
    sociodemo[[i]] <- table(dfsub$group,dfsub[,variables[i]],exclude=NA)
  }
  
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## chi squares worden berekend
    test[[i]] <- paste('χ2(',chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$parameter,') = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$statistic,2),', p = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value,2),
                       pformat(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value),
                       sep="")
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen in percentages
    sociodemo[[i]] <- as.data.frame(round(prop.table(sociodemo[[i]],1)*100,2))
  }
  
  testlabels <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## p waarde 0 wordt vervangen door <.001
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) <.001){
      testlabels[[i]] <- gsub("p = 0","p = <.001",test[[i]])
    } else {
      testlabels[[i]] <- test[[i]]
    }
  }
  testlabels
  
  
  names(sociodemo)<- names[[j]]
  
  g<-list() # aanmaken van figuren
  a <- sociodemo
  for(i in 1:length(a)) {
    p = ggplot(reshape2::melt(a[[i]]), aes(as.factor(Var1), value, 
                                           fill=as.factor(Var2), 
                                           label=paste(round(value, 0),sep="") ))+
      geom_col()+geom_text(position=position_stack(vjust=0.5))+
      coord_flip()+scale_fill_brewer(type="seq", palette=1)+
      labs(x="", y="", title=names(a)[i], fill = "Categorieën: ",
           subtitle=testlabels[i]
      )+
      theme_hc(base_size = 10)+
      theme(legend.position='right')
    g[[i]] = p
    
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## er wordt gecheckt welke significant is of niet
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) >.05){
      g[[i]] <- g[[i]] + scale_fill_brewer(type="seq",palette=6)
    }  
  }
  
  # figuur ----
  
  plot_list[[j]] <- ggarrange(plotlist=g, align = "hv",# totale plot
                              common.legend=FALSE,
                              ncol = 1, nrow = 3 # aantal rijen en kolommen
  )
}


mean_df <- df_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(wave, item) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sum_w = sum(weights[!is.na(score) & !is.na(weights)], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_w = ifelse(sum_w > 0,
                    sum(score * weights, na.rm = TRUE) / sum_w,
                    NA_real_),
    n = sum(!is.na(score)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )%>%as.data.frame()

items_with_lines <- mean_df %>%
  dplyr::count(item) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n >= 2) %>%   # at least two waves → line possible
  dplyr::pull(item)

  filter(item %in% items_with_lines)

mean_df <- mean_df %>%
  mutate(item_label = col_labels[item])

mean_df_lines$item <- as.factor(mean_df_lines$item)

 scale_color_manual(
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=14, out.width="100%",fig.asp=1, dpi=300}
cols <- c("amot_1",
     "amot_2",
     "amot_3",
     "amot_4",
     "verzet")
codenames <- c(
  "Distrust in crisis approach",
  "Exhaustion / effort depletion",
  "Low perceived competence",
  "Perceived ineffectiveness of personal action",
  "Active non-compliance"
)
col_labels <- c(
  "Because I do not believe that the current approach to the COVID-19 crisis helps to solve the problem.",
  "Because I can no longer make the necessary sacrifices or put in the required effort.",
  "Because I do not feel capable of complying with the imposed measures.",
  "Because the COVID-19 crisis is so large that my behavior has only a limited impact.",
  "I completely disregard the measures."
)

item_colors <- c(
  # Amotivation – low energy / futility (grey–blue)
  amot_1 = "#6C757D",  # Distrust in crisis approach (cognitive disengagement)
  amot_2 = "#5A5A5A",  # Exhaustion / effort depletion
  amot_3 = "#495057",  # Low perceived competence
  amot_4 = "#343A40",  # Perceived ineffectiveness of personal action
  
  # Active resistance – qualitatively different (dark red)
  verzet = "#9B2226"   # Active non-compliance
)

names(item_colors) <- codenames
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.asp=0.3, dpi=300}
items <- cols

make_wave_long <- function(df, wave_id, cols) {
  cols_here <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if (length(cols_here) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df %>%
    select(email, weights, all_of(cols_here)) %>%   # <-- include weights
    mutate(wave = wave_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(cols_here),
      names_to = "item",
      values_to = "score"
    )
}

variableslist <- list(
  fig0 = c('age_group','gender','region'))
names <- list(
  fig0 = c('Age group','Gender','Region'))

pformat <- function(p.value){
  unclass(symnum(p.value, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE, 
                 cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), 
                 symbols = c("***", "**", "*", " ")))
}

plot_list = list()
plot_list3 = list()
sociodemo <- c()
test <- c()
testlabels <- c()

for(j in 1:length(variableslist)) {
  i <- 1
  variables <- variableslist[[j]]
  
  sociodemo <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables)) # lengte aanpassen
  test <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen worden gemaakt
    sociodemo[[i]] <- table(dfsub$group,dfsub[,variables[i]],exclude=NA)
  }
  
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## chi squares worden berekend
    test[[i]] <- paste('χ2(',chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$parameter,') = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$statistic,2),', p = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value,2),
                       pformat(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value),
                       sep="")
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen in percentages
    sociodemo[[i]] <- as.data.frame(round(prop.table(sociodemo[[i]],1)*100,2))
  }
  
  testlabels <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## p waarde 0 wordt vervangen door <.001
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) <.001){
      testlabels[[i]] <- gsub("p = 0","p = <.001",test[[i]])
    } else {
      testlabels[[i]] <- test[[i]]
    }
  }
  testlabels
  
  
  names(sociodemo)<- names[[j]]
  
  g<-list() # aanmaken van figuren
  a <- sociodemo
  for(i in 1:length(a)) {
    p = ggplot(reshape2::melt(a[[i]]), aes(as.factor(Var1), value, 
                                           fill=as.factor(Var2), 
                                           label=paste(round(value, 0),sep="") ))+
      geom_col()+geom_text(position=position_stack(vjust=0.5))+
      coord_flip()+scale_fill_brewer(type="seq", palette=1)+
      labs(x="", y="", title=names(a)[i], fill = "Categorieën: ",
           subtitle=testlabels[i]
      )+
      theme_hc(base_size = 10)+
      theme(legend.position='right')
    g[[i]] = p
    
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## er wordt gecheckt welke significant is of niet
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) >.05){
      g[[i]] <- g[[i]] + scale_fill_brewer(type="seq",palette=6)
    }  
  }
  
  # figuur ----
  
  plot_list[[j]] <- ggarrange(plotlist=g, align = "hv",# totale plot
                              common.legend=FALSE,
                              ncol = 1, nrow = 3 # aantal rijen en kolommen
  )
}


mean_df <- df_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(wave, item) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sum_w = sum(weights[!is.na(score) & !is.na(weights)], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_w = ifelse(sum_w > 0,
                    sum(score * weights, na.rm = TRUE) / sum_w,
                    NA_real_),
    n = sum(!is.na(score)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )%>%as.data.frame()

items_with_lines <- mean_df %>%
  dplyr::count(item) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n >= 2) %>%   # at least two waves → line possible
  dplyr::pull(item)

  filter(item %in% items_with_lines)

mean_df$item <- as.factor(mean_df$item)
mean_df <- mean_df %>%
  mutate(item_label = col_labels[item])
mean_df[which(mean_df$n<100),] <- NA

mean_df_lines$item <- as.factor(mean_df_lines$item)
mean_df_lines <- mean_df_lines %>%
  mutate(item_label = col_labels[item])

mean_df_lines[which(mean_df_lines$n<100),] <- NA

p <- ggplot(mean_df,
            aes(
              x = wave,
              y = mean_w,
              color = item,
              shape = item,
              group = item,
              text = paste0(
                "Item: ", item_label,
                "<br>Code: ", item,
                "<br>Wave: ", wave,
                "<br>Weighted mean: ", round(mean_w, 2),
                "<br>N: ", n

            )) +

    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = item_colors,

  )+
  scale_shape_manual(

   scale_x_discrete(labels = c(

    "7"='End of<br>2022',
    "8"='End of<br>2024',
    "9"='End of<br>2025'
  ))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1, 5), expand = expansion(mult = c(.02, .05))) +

fig %>% plotly::layout(
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.asp=0.3, dpi=300}
items <- cols

make_wave_long <- function(df, wave_id, cols) {
  cols_here <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if (length(cols_here) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df %>%
    select(email, weights, all_of(cols_here)) %>%   # <-- include weights
    mutate(wave = wave_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(cols_here),
      names_to = "item",
      values_to = "score"
    )
}

dfsub <- dfsub[!is.na(dfsub$gender),]
dfsub <- dfsub[!is.na(dfsub$region),]
dfsub <- dfsub[!is.na(dfsub$group),]
dfsub <- droplevels(dfsub)
dfsub <- as.data.frame(dfsub)

variableslist <- list(
  fig0 = c('age_group','gender','region'))
names <- list(
  fig0 = c('Age group','Gender','Region'))

pformat <- function(p.value){
  unclass(symnum(p.value, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE, 
                 cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), 
                 symbols = c("***", "**", "*", " ")))
}

plot_list = list()
plot_list3 = list()
sociodemo <- c()
test <- c()
testlabels <- c()

for(j in 1:length(variableslist)) {
  i <- 1
  variables <- variableslist[[j]]
  
  sociodemo <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables)) # lengte aanpassen
  test <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen worden gemaakt
    sociodemo[[i]] <- table(dfsub$group,dfsub[,variables[i]],exclude=NA)
  }
  
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## chi squares worden berekend
    test[[i]] <- paste('χ2(',chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$parameter,') = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$statistic,2),', p = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value,2),
                       pformat(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value),
                       sep="")
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen in percentages
    sociodemo[[i]] <- as.data.frame(round(prop.table(sociodemo[[i]],1)*100,2))
  }
  
  testlabels <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## p waarde 0 wordt vervangen door <.001
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) <.001){
      testlabels[[i]] <- gsub("p = 0","p = <.001",test[[i]])
    } else {
      testlabels[[i]] <- test[[i]]
    }
  }
  testlabels
  
  
  names(sociodemo)<- names[[j]]
  
  g<-list() # aanmaken van figuren
  a <- sociodemo
  for(i in 1:length(a)) {
    p = ggplot(reshape2::melt(a[[i]]), aes(as.factor(Var1), value, 
                                           fill=as.factor(Var2), 
                                           label=paste(round(value, 0),sep="") ))+
      geom_col()+geom_text(position=position_stack(vjust=0.5))+
      coord_flip()+scale_fill_brewer(type="seq", palette=1)+
      labs(x="", y="", title=names(a)[i], fill = "Categorieën: ",
           subtitle=testlabels[i]
      )+
      theme_hc(base_size = 10)+
      theme(legend.position='right')
    g[[i]] = p
    
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## er wordt gecheckt welke significant is of niet
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) >.05){
      g[[i]] <- g[[i]] + scale_fill_brewer(type="seq",palette=6)
    }  
  }
  
  # figuur ----
  
  plot_list[[j]] <- ggarrange(plotlist=g, align = "hv",# totale plot
                              common.legend=FALSE,
                              ncol = 1, nrow = 3 # aantal rijen en kolommen
  )
}


mean_df <- df_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(wave, item) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sum_w = sum(weights[!is.na(score) & !is.na(weights)], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_w = ifelse(sum_w > 0,
                    sum(score * weights, na.rm = TRUE) / sum_w,
                    NA_real_),
    n = sum(!is.na(score)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )%>%as.data.frame()

items_with_lines <- mean_df %>%
  dplyr::count(item) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n >= 2) %>%   # at least two waves → line possible
  dplyr::pull(item)

  filter(item %in% items_with_lines)

  mutate(item_label = col_labels[item])
mean_df[which(mean_df$n<100),] <- NA

 scale_color_manual(
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.asp=0.3, dpi=300}
items <- cols

make_wave_long <- function(df, wave_id, cols) {
  cols_here <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if (length(cols_here) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df %>%
    select(email, weights, all_of(cols_here)) %>%   # <-- include weights
    mutate(wave = wave_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(cols_here),
      names_to = "item",
      values_to = "score"
    )
}

  make_wave_long(dfwave3,         4, cols),

) %>%

minaantal <- 40
tableregion <- as.data.frame(table(dfuniquek$wave,dfuniquek$region))
colnames(tableregion) <- c('wave','region','Freq')
tableregion$combo <- paste0(tableregion$wave,tableregion$region)
removedgender <- tableregion[which(tableregion$Freq<minaantal),'combo']
tableregion[which(tableregion$Freq<minaantal),'Freq'] <- 'NOWP'
df_long$combo <- paste0(df_long$wave,df_long$region)
df_long$Freq <- tableregion$Freq[match(df_long$combo,tableregion$combo)]
df_long <- df_long[!(df_long$Freq %in% "NOWP"), ]

tableage_group <- as.data.frame(table(dfuniquek$wave,dfuniquek$age_group))
colnames(tableage_group) <- c('wave','age_group','Freq')
tableage_group$combo <- paste(tableage_group$wave,tableage_group$age_group,sep="-")
removedage <- tableage_group[which(tableage_group$Freq<minaantal),'combo']
tableage_group[which(tableage_group$Freq<minaantal),'Freq'] <- 'NOWP'
df_long$combo <- paste(df_long$wave,df_long$age_group,sep="-")
df_long$Freq <- tableage_group$Freq[match(df_long$combo,tableage_group$combo)]
df_long <- df_long[!(df_long$Freq %in% "NOWP"), ]

tablegender$combo <- paste(tablegender$wave,tablegender$gender,sep="-")
removedgender <- tablegender[which(tablegender$Freq<minaantal),'combo']
tablegender[which(tablegender$Freq<minaantal),'Freq'] <- 'NOWP'

dfsub <- df_long
dfsub$group <- dfsub$waves
levels(dfsub$group) <- c('COVID wave I','COVID wave II','End of 2020',
                           'COVID wave III','End of 2021','Post-COVID',
                           'End of 2022','End of 2024','End of 2025')
dfsub <- dfsub[!is.na(dfsub$age_group),]
dfsub <- dfsub[!is.na(dfsub$gender),]
dfsub <- dfsub[!is.na(dfsub$region),]
dfsub <- dfsub[!is.na(dfsub$group),]
dfsub <- droplevels(dfsub)
dfsub <- as.data.frame(dfsub)

variableslist <- list(
  fig0 = c('age_group','gender','region'))
names <- list(
  fig0 = c('Age group','Gender','Region'))

pformat <- function(p.value){
  unclass(symnum(p.value, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE, 
                 cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), 
                 symbols = c("***", "**", "*", " ")))
}

plot_list = list()
plot_list3 = list()
sociodemo <- c()
test <- c()
testlabels <- c()

for(j in 1:length(variableslist)) {
  i <- 1
  variables <- variableslist[[j]]
  
  sociodemo <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables)) # lengte aanpassen
  test <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen worden gemaakt
    sociodemo[[i]] <- table(dfsub$group,dfsub[,variables[i]],exclude=NA)
  }
  
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## chi squares worden berekend
    test[[i]] <- paste('χ2(',chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$parameter,') = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$statistic,2),', p = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value,2),
                       pformat(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value),
                       sep="")
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen in percentages
    sociodemo[[i]] <- as.data.frame(round(prop.table(sociodemo[[i]],1)*100,2))
  }
  
  testlabels <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## p waarde 0 wordt vervangen door <.001
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) <.001){
      testlabels[[i]] <- gsub("p = 0","p = <.001",test[[i]])
    } else {
      testlabels[[i]] <- test[[i]]
    }
  }
  testlabels
  
  
  names(sociodemo)<- names[[j]]
  
  g<-list() # aanmaken van figuren
  a <- sociodemo
  for(i in 1:length(a)) {
    p = ggplot(reshape2::melt(a[[i]]), aes(as.factor(Var1), value, 
                                           fill=as.factor(Var2), 
                                           label=paste(round(value, 0),sep="") ))+
      geom_col()+geom_text(position=position_stack(vjust=0.5))+
      coord_flip()+scale_fill_brewer(type="seq", palette=1)+
      labs(x="", y="", title=names(a)[i], fill = "Categorieën: ",
           subtitle=testlabels[i]
      )+
      theme_hc(base_size = 10)+
      theme(legend.position='right')
    g[[i]] = p
    
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## er wordt gecheckt welke significant is of niet
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) >.05){
      g[[i]] <- g[[i]] + scale_fill_brewer(type="seq",palette=6)
    }  
  }
  
  # figuur ----
  
  plot_list[[j]] <- ggarrange(plotlist=g, align = "hv",# totale plot
                              common.legend=FALSE,
                              ncol = 1, nrow = 3 # aantal rijen en kolommen
  )
}


mean_df <- df_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(wave, item) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sum_w = sum(weights[!is.na(score) & !is.na(weights)], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_w = ifelse(sum_w > 0,
                    sum(score * weights, na.rm = TRUE) / sum_w,
                    NA_real_),
    n = sum(!is.na(score)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )%>%as.data.frame()

items_with_lines <- mean_df %>%
  dplyr::count(item) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n >= 2) %>%   # at least two waves → line possible
  dplyr::pull(item)

mean_df_lines <- mean_df %>%
  filter(item %in% items_with_lines)

mean_df$item <- as.factor(mean_df$item)
mean_df <- mean_df %>%
  mutate(item_label = col_labels[item])
mean_df[which(mean_df$n<100),] <- NA

mean_df_lines$item <- as.factor(mean_df_lines$item)
mean_df_lines <- mean_df_lines %>%
  mutate(item_label = col_labels[item])

mean_df_lines[which(mean_df_lines$n<100),] <- NA
mean_df$wave <- as.factor(mean_df$wave);levels(mean_df$item) <- codenames;mean_df<-na.omit(mean_df)
mean_df_lines$wave <- as.factor(mean_df_lines$wave);levels(mean_df_lines$item) <- codenames;mean_df_lines<-na.omit(mean_df_lines)

p <- ggplot(mean_df,
            aes(
              x = wave,
              y = mean_w,
              color = item,
              shape = item,
              group = item,
              text = paste0(
                "Item: ", item_label,
                "<br>Code: ", item,
                "<br>Wave: ", wave,
                "<br>Weighted mean: ", round(mean_w, 2),
                "<br>N: ", n
              )
            )) +
  geom_line(
    data = mean_df_lines,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
 scale_color_manual(
    values = item_colors,
    breaks = names(item_colors),   # keeps order stable
    labels = col_labels             # optional: pretty legend
  )+
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = rep(c(16, 17, 15, 18, 3, 7),
                 length.out = length(unique(mean_df$item))),
    labels = col_labels
  ) +
   scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "1"='COVID<br>wave I',
    "2"= 'COVID<br>wave II',
    "3"='End of<br>2020',
    "4"='COVID<br>wave III',
    "5"='End of<br>2021',
    "6"='Post-COVID',
    "7"='End of<br>2022',
    "8"='End of<br>2024',
    "9"='End of<br>2025'
  ))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1, 5), expand = expansion(mult = c(.02, .05))) +
  labs(
    
    caption = paste0("Weighted; total longitudinal N = ", n_longitudinal),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean score"
  ) + theme_minimal()

fig <- ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")

fig %>% plotly::layout(
  margin = list(b = 120),
  annotations = list(list(
     text = paste0(
      "Weighted; total longitudinal N = ", n_longitudinal,
      "<br>with at least ",
      round(aantalwaves,0),"/",maxwaves," waves"

    x = 0, y = 0,                 # keep INSIDE paper

    yshift = -70,                 # push it DOWN into the bottom margin
    showarrow = FALSE,

  ))
)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=14, out.width="100%",fig.asp=0.5, dpi=300}
top_age_by_wave <- df_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(weights), !is.na(age_group)) %>%
  group_by(wave, age_group) %>%
  summarise(mean_w = mean(weights, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(wave) %>%
  slice_max(mean_w, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

ageweights <- top_age_by_wave %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(wave), y = mean_w, label = age_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.7, size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Wave",
    y = "Mean weight of most-upweighted age group",
    title = "Most upweighted age group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

top_region_by_wave <- df_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(weights), !is.na(region)) %>%
  group_by(wave, region) %>%
  summarise(mean_w = mean(weights, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(wave) %>%
  slice_max(mean_w, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

regionweights <- top_region_by_wave %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(wave), y = mean_w, label = region)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.7, size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Wave",
    y = "Mean weight of most-upweighted region group",
    title = "Most upweighted region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

top_gender_by_wave <- df_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(weights), !is.na(gender)) %>%
  group_by(wave, gender) %>%
  summarise(mean_w = mean(weights, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(wave) %>%
  slice_max(mean_w, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

genderweights <- top_gender_by_wave %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(wave), y = mean_w, label = gender)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.7, size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Wave",
    y = "Mean weight of most-upweighted gender group",
    title = "Most upweighted gender"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

ggarrange(ageweights, regionweights, genderweights, ncol = 3, nrow = 1)
```

## Populism

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=14, out.width="100%",fig.asp=1, dpi=300}

cols <- c('populism_1','populism_2','populism_3','populism_4','populism_5')
codenames <- c(
  "Politicians talk instead of acting",
  "Preference for citizen representatives",
  "Primacy of the popular will",
  "People over politicians in decision-making",
  "Rejection of political compromise"
)

col_labels <- c(
  "Elected politicians talk too much and take too little action.",
  "I would rather be represented by an ordinary citizen than by a professional politician.",
  "Politicians in the national parliament should follow the will of the people.",
  "The people, not politicians, should make the most important decisions for our country.",
  "What is called a ‘compromise’ in politics is in reality a sacrifice of principles."
)

item_colors <- c(
  populism_1 = "#F4A261",  # politicians talk instead of acting
  populism_2 = "#E76F51",  # preference for citizen representatives
  populism_3 = "#D97706",  # primacy of the popular will
  populism_4 = "#C2410C",  # people over politicians
  populism_5 = "#9A3412"   # rejection of political compromise
)
names(item_colors) <- codenames
```

## Longitudinal

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.asp=0.3, dpi=300}
items <- cols

make_wave_long <- function(df, wave_id, cols) {
  cols_here <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if (length(cols_here) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df %>%
    select(email, weights, all_of(cols_here)) %>%   # <-- include weights
    mutate(wave = wave_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(cols_here),
      names_to = "item",
      values_to = "score"
    )
}

df_long <- bind_rows(
  make_wave_long(df2020begin,     1, cols),
  make_wave_long(df2020wave2,     2, cols),
  make_wave_long(df2020long,      3, cols),
  make_wave_long(dfwave3,         4, cols),
  make_wave_long(df2021long,      5, cols),
  make_wave_long(df2022postcovid, 6, cols),
  make_wave_long(df2022long,      7, cols),
  make_wave_long(df2024long,      8, cols),
  make_wave_long(df2025long,      9, cols)
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(score)) %>%                      # drop NAs per-item (not whole rows)
  mutate(item = factor(item, levels = cols))

maxwaves <- dim(df_long %>% dplyr::count(wave, name = "n_values"))[1]
aantalwaves <- maxwaves-(maxwaves/2)+1


emails_longitudinal <- df_long %>%
  dplyr::distinct(email, wave) %>%
  dplyr::count(email) %>%
  filter(n >= aantalwaves) %>%          # your "at least 6/9 waves" criterion (exactly 6 here)
  pull(email)

df_long <- df_long %>%
  filter(email %in% emails_longitudinal)

n_longitudinal <- n_distinct(df_long$email)
#n_longitudinal


# ADD WEIGHTS

dfsub <- na.omit(dfmot[,c("email","province")])
df_long$province <- dfsub$province[match(df_long$email,dfsub$email)]
df_long$province <- as.factor(df_long$province)
#freq(df_long$province)
#print(paste('the number of missing provinces is',length(unique(df_long[is.na(df_long$province),'email']))))
#levels(df_long$province)
levels(df_long$province) <- c('West-Vlaanderen',
                            'Oost-Vlaanderen',
                            'Antwerpen',
                            'Limburg',
                            'Vlaams-Brabant',
                            'Andere',
                            'Henegouwen',
                            'Namen',
                            'Luik',
                            'Luxemburg',
                            'Waals-Brabant',
                            'Brussels Hoofdstedelijk Gewest')
df_long$region <- df_long$province
levels(df_long$region) <- c('Flanders','Flanders','Flanders','Flanders','Flanders',NA,
                          'Wallonia','Wallonia','Wallonia','Wallonia','Wallonia',
                          'Brussels')
df_long$region_w <- plyr::revalue(df_long$region, c("Flanders"="1","Wallonia"="2","Brussels"="3"))

dfsub <- na.omit(dfmot[,c("email","gender")])
df_long$gender <- dfsub$gender[match(df_long$email,dfsub$email)]
df_long$gender <- as.factor(df_long$gender)
#print(paste('the number of missing gender is',length(unique(df_long[is.na(df_long$gender),'email']))))

#freq(df_long$gender)
#levels(df_long$gender)
levels(df_long$gender) <- c('Male','Female')
df_long$gender_w <- as.factor(df_long$gender)
levels(df_long$gender_w) <- c('Male','Female')
df_long$gender_w <- plyr::revalue(df_long$gender_w, c("Female"="2", "Male"="1"))

pformat <- function(p.value){
  unclass(symnum(p.value, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE, 
                 cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), 
                 symbols = c("***", "**", "*", " ")))
}

plot_list = list()
plot_list3 = list()
sociodemo <- c()
test <- c()
testlabels <- c()

for(j in 1:length(variableslist)) {
  i <- 1
  variables <- variableslist[[j]]
  
  sociodemo <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables)) # lengte aanpassen
  test <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen worden gemaakt
    sociodemo[[i]] <- table(dfsub$group,dfsub[,variables[i]],exclude=NA)
  }
  
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## chi squares worden berekend
    test[[i]] <- paste('χ2(',chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$parameter,') = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$statistic,2),', p = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value,2),
                       pformat(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value),
                       sep="")
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen in percentages
    sociodemo[[i]] <- as.data.frame(round(prop.table(sociodemo[[i]],1)*100,2))
  }
  
  testlabels <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## p waarde 0 wordt vervangen door <.001
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) <.001){
      testlabels[[i]] <- gsub("p = 0","p = <.001",test[[i]])
    } else {
      testlabels[[i]] <- test[[i]]
    }
  }
  testlabels
  
  
  names(sociodemo)<- names[[j]]
  
  g<-list() # aanmaken van figuren
  a <- sociodemo
  for(i in 1:length(a)) {
    p = ggplot(reshape2::melt(a[[i]]), aes(as.factor(Var1), value, 
                                           fill=as.factor(Var2), 
                                           label=paste(round(value, 0),sep="") ))+
      geom_col()+geom_text(position=position_stack(vjust=0.5))+
      coord_flip()+scale_fill_brewer(type="seq", palette=1)+
      labs(x="", y="", title=names(a)[i], fill = "Categorieën: ",
           subtitle=testlabels[i]
      )+
      theme_hc(base_size = 10)+
      theme(legend.position='right')
    g[[i]] = p
    
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## er wordt gecheckt welke significant is of niet
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) >.05){
      g[[i]] <- g[[i]] + scale_fill_brewer(type="seq",palette=6)
    }  
  }
  
  # figuur ----
  
  plot_list[[j]] <- ggarrange(plotlist=g, align = "hv",# totale plot
                              common.legend=FALSE,
                              ncol = 1, nrow = 3 # aantal rijen en kolommen
  )
}


mean_df <- df_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(wave, item) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sum_w = sum(weights[!is.na(score) & !is.na(weights)], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_w = ifelse(sum_w > 0,
                    sum(score * weights, na.rm = TRUE) / sum_w,
                    NA_real_),
    n = sum(!is.na(score)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )%>%as.data.frame()
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.asp=0.3, dpi=300}
items <- cols

make_wave_long <- function(df, wave_id, cols) {
  cols_here <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if (length(cols_here) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df %>%
    select(email, weights, all_of(cols_here)) %>%   # <-- include weights
    mutate(wave = wave_id) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(cols_here),
      names_to = "item",
      values_to = "score"
    )
}

  make_wave_long(df2025long,      9, cols)
) %>%

dfuniquek <- na.omit(unique(df_long[,c('email','age_group','gender','region','wave')]))
minaantal <- 40
tableregion <- as.data.frame(table(dfuniquek$wave,dfuniquek$region))
colnames(tableregion) <- c('wave','region','Freq')
tableregion$combo <- paste0(tableregion$wave,tableregion$region)
removedgender <- tableregion[which(tableregion$Freq<minaantal),'combo']
tableregion[which(tableregion$Freq<minaantal),'Freq'] <- 'NOWP'
df_long$combo <- paste0(df_long$wave,df_long$region)
df_long$Freq <- tableregion$Freq[match(df_long$combo,tableregion$combo)]
df_long <- df_long[!(df_long$Freq %in% "NOWP"), ]

tableage_group <- as.data.frame(table(dfuniquek$wave,dfuniquek$age_group))
colnames(tableage_group) <- c('wave','age_group','Freq')
tableage_group$combo <- paste(tableage_group$wave,tableage_group$age_group,sep="-")
removedage <- tableage_group[which(tableage_group$Freq<minaantal),'combo']
tableage_group[which(tableage_group$Freq<minaantal),'Freq'] <- 'NOWP'
df_long$combo <- paste(df_long$wave,df_long$age_group,sep="-")
df_long$Freq <- tableage_group$Freq[match(df_long$combo,tableage_group$combo)]
df_long <- df_long[!(df_long$Freq %in% "NOWP"), ]

tablegender <- as.data.frame(table(dfuniquek$wave,dfuniquek$gender))
colnames(tablegender) <- c('wave','gender','Freq')
tablegender$combo <- paste(tablegender$wave,tablegender$gender,sep="-")
removedgender <- tablegender[which(tablegender$Freq<minaantal),'combo']
tablegender[which(tablegender$Freq<minaantal),'Freq'] <- 'NOWP'
df_long$combo <- paste(df_long$wave,df_long$gender,sep="-")
df_long$Freq <- tablegender$Freq[match(df_long$combo,tablegender$combo)]
df_long <- df_long[!(df_long$Freq %in% "NOWP"), ]

dfsub <- df_long
dfsub$group <- dfsub$waves
levels(dfsub$group) <- c('COVID wave I','COVID wave II','End of 2020',
                           'COVID wave III','End of 2021','Post-COVID',
                           'End of 2022','End of 2024','End of 2025')
dfsub <- dfsub[!is.na(dfsub$age_group),]
dfsub <- dfsub[!is.na(dfsub$gender),]
dfsub <- dfsub[!is.na(dfsub$region),]
dfsub <- dfsub[!is.na(dfsub$group),]
dfsub <- droplevels(dfsub)
dfsub <- as.data.frame(dfsub)

variableslist <- list(
  fig0 = c('age_group','gender','region'))
names <- list(
  fig0 = c('Age group','Gender','Region'))

pformat <- function(p.value){
  unclass(symnum(p.value, corr = FALSE, na = FALSE, 
                 cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), 
                 symbols = c("***", "**", "*", " ")))
}

plot_list = list()
plot_list3 = list()
sociodemo <- c()
test <- c()
testlabels <- c()

for(j in 1:length(variableslist)) {
  i <- 1
  variables <- variableslist[[j]]
  
  sociodemo <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables)) # lengte aanpassen
  test <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen worden gemaakt
    sociodemo[[i]] <- table(dfsub$group,dfsub[,variables[i]],exclude=NA)
  }
  
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## chi squares worden berekend
    test[[i]] <- paste('χ2(',chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$parameter,') = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$statistic,2),', p = ',
                       round(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value,2),
                       pformat(chisq.test(sociodemo[[i]])$p.value),
                       sep="")
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## tabellen in percentages
    sociodemo[[i]] <- as.data.frame(round(prop.table(sociodemo[[i]],1)*100,2))
  }
  
  testlabels <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(variables))
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## p waarde 0 wordt vervangen door <.001
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) <.001){
      testlabels[[i]] <- gsub("p = 0","p = <.001",test[[i]])
    } else {
      testlabels[[i]] <- test[[i]]
    }
  }
  testlabels
  
  
  names(sociodemo)<- names[[j]]
  
  g<-list() # aanmaken van figuren
  a <- sociodemo
  for(i in 1:length(a)) {
    p = ggplot(reshape2::melt(a[[i]]), aes(as.factor(Var1), value, 
                                           fill=as.factor(Var2), 
                                           label=paste(round(value, 0),sep="") ))+
      geom_col()+geom_text(position=position_stack(vjust=0.5))+
      coord_flip()+scale_fill_brewer(type="seq", palette=1)+
      labs(x="", y="", title=names(a)[i], fill = "Categorieën: ",
           subtitle=testlabels[i]
      )+
      theme_hc(base_size = 10)+
      theme(legend.position='right')
    g[[i]] = p
    
  }
  
  for(i in 1:length(variables)) { ## er wordt gecheckt welke significant is of niet
    if(as.numeric(gsub("\\*", "", gsub(".*p =","",test[[i]]))) >.05){
      g[[i]] <- g[[i]] + scale_fill_brewer(type="seq",palette=6)
    }  
  }
  
  # figuur ----
  
  plot_list[[j]] <- ggarrange(plotlist=g, align = "hv",# totale plot
                              common.legend=FALSE,
                              ncol = 1, nrow = 3 # aantal rijen en kolommen
  )
}


mean_df <- df_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(wave, item) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sum_w = sum(weights[!is.na(score) & !is.na(weights)], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_w = ifelse(sum_w > 0,
                    sum(score * weights, na.rm = TRUE) / sum_w,
                    NA_real_),
    n = sum(!is.na(score)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )%>%as.data.frame()

items_with_lines <- mean_df %>%
  dplyr::count(item) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n >= 2) %>%   # at least two waves → line possible
  dplyr::pull(item)

mean_df_lines <- mean_df %>%
  filter(item %in% items_with_lines)

mean_df$item <- as.factor(mean_df$item)
mean_df <- mean_df %>%
  mutate(item_label = col_labels[item])
mean_df[which(mean_df$n<100),] <- NA

mean_df_lines$item <- as.factor(mean_df_lines$item)
mean_df_lines <- mean_df_lines %>%
  mutate(item_label = col_labels[item])

mean_df_lines[which(mean_df_lines$n<100),] <- NA
mean_df$wave <- as.factor(mean_df$wave);levels(mean_df$item) <- codenames;mean_df<-na.omit(mean_df)
mean_df_lines$wave <- as.factor(mean_df_lines$wave);levels(mean_df_lines$item) <- codenames;mean_df_lines<-na.omit(mean_df_lines)

p <- ggplot(mean_df,
            aes(
              x = wave,
              y = mean_w,
              color = item,
              shape = item,
              group = item,
              text = paste0(
                "Item: ", item_label,
                "<br>Code: ", item,
                "<br>Wave: ", wave,
                "<br>Weighted mean: ", round(mean_w, 2),
                "<br>N: ", n
              )
            )) +
  geom_line(
    data = mean_df_lines,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
 scale_color_manual(
    values = item_colors,
    breaks = names(item_colors),   # keeps order stable
    labels = col_labels             # optional: pretty legend
  )+
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = rep(c(16, 17, 15, 18, 3, 7),
                 length.out = length(unique(mean_df$item))),
    labels = col_labels
  ) +
   scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "1"='COVID<br>wave I',
    "2"= 'COVID<br>wave II',
    "3"='End of<br>2020',
    "4"='COVID<br>wave III',
    "5"='End of<br>2021',
    "6"='Post-COVID',
    "7"='End of<br>2022',
    "8"='End of<br>2024',
    "9"='End of<br>2025'
  ))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1, 10), expand = expansion(mult = c(.02, .05))) +
  labs(
    
    caption = paste0("Weighted; total longitudinal N = ", n_longitudinal),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean score"
  ) + theme_minimal()

fig <- ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")

fig %>% plotly::layout(
  margin = list(b = 120),
  annotations = list(list(
     text = paste0(
      "Weighted; total longitudinal N = ", n_longitudinal,
      "<br>with at least ",
      round(aantalwaves,0),"/",maxwaves," waves"
    ),
    x = 0, y = 0,                 # keep INSIDE paper
    xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
    xanchor = "left", yanchor = "top",
    yshift = -70,                 # push it DOWN into the bottom margin
    showarrow = FALSE,
    align = "left",
    font = list(family = "Arial", size = 10)
  ))
)
```

## Weights
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=14, out.width="100%",fig.asp=0.5, dpi=300}

top_age_by_wave <- df_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(weights), !is.na(age_group)) %>%
  group_by(wave, age_group) %>%
  summarise(mean_w = mean(weights, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(wave) %>%
  slice_max(mean_w, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

ageweights <- top_age_by_wave %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(wave), y = mean_w, label = age_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.7, size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Wave",
    y = "Mean weight of most-upweighted age group",
    title = "Most upweighted age group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

top_region_by_wave <- df_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(weights), !is.na(region)) %>%
  group_by(wave, region) %>%
  summarise(mean_w = mean(weights, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(wave) %>%
  slice_max(mean_w, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

regionweights <- top_region_by_wave %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(wave), y = mean_w, label = region)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.7, size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Wave",
    y = "Mean weight of most-upweighted region group",
    title = "Most upweighted region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

top_gender_by_wave <- df_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(weights), !is.na(gender)) %>%
  group_by(wave, gender) %>%
  summarise(mean_w = mean(weights, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%

  slice_max(mean_w, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

genderweights <- top_gender_by_wave %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(wave), y = mean_w, label = gender)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.7, size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Wave",
    y = "Mean weight of most-upweighted gender group",
    title = "Most upweighted gender"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

ggarrange(ageweights, regionweights, genderweights, ncol = 3, nrow = 1)
```
